scope: Player ground baneling melee approach behavior fix; not a performance gain or global movement rewrite.

source.boundary: S06 final frozen inputs; two S09 simulation inputs differ. Only player ground baneling approach behavior changes. Original damage, radius, cooldown, enemies, other families, collision solver and terrain unchanged.

behavior.method: Actual production World.step, 900 ticks per case. No direct fire, windup/recovery reset or source range/damage/speed edit. Target high HP/stopped attack is diagnostic. Mixed-live allies retain autonomous movement/attack.

cost.method: Current source planner only, 12 rounds, cold forces route expiry; hot 300 repeated calls. Diagnostic 301 enemies exercise filtering; not normal 300 cap or full World.step/FPS. No claim of performance improvement; new routing has a CPU cost.
